scripts.hotrepl:build: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${HOTREPL_REPO:?set HOTREPL_REPO}"; dotnet build "$HOTREPL_REPO/src/HotRepl.BepInEx" --nologo -v q'
scripts.hotrepl:deploy: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${HOTREPL_BEPINEX_OUT:?set HOTREPL_BEPINEX_OUT}"; : "${ARDENFALL_MOD_OUT:=./mod/bin/Debug/netstandard2.1}"; : "${ARDENFALL_PLUGINS_DIR:?set ARDENFALL_PLUGINS_DIR}"; bun run controller:deploy -- --hotrepl-out "$HOTREPL_BEPINEX_OUT" --mod-out "$ARDENFALL_MOD_OUT" --plugins "$ARDENFALL_PLUGINS_DIR" --bind-host "${HOTREPL_BIND_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"'
scripts.hotrepl:setup: bun run hotrepl:build && bun run mod:copy-libs && bun run mod:build && bun run hotrepl:deploy
scripts.hotrepl:export: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${HOTREPL_URL:?set HOTREPL_URL}"; : "${ARDENFALL_SNAPSHOT_OUT:=./snapshots}"; : "${ARDENFALL_PIPELINE_OUT:=./pipeline/dist}"; bun run controller:export -- --url "$HOTREPL_URL" --token "${HOTREPL_TOKEN:-}" --output "$ARDENFALL_SNAPSHOT_OUT" --pipeline-out "$ARDENFALL_PIPELINE_OUT"'
